history.summary: Tiny 30-unit freehold boutique at Joo Chiat Place, D15, 2BR at $1.46M / $1,443psf on 1,012sqft. Freehold East Coast and a low PSF look appealing, and arena score is high (833), but the headline 11.03% URA rests on just 7 transactions — statistically meaningless — and a 30-unit project is structurally illiquid. The thin-data, thin-market combination dominates the call.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold in Joo Chiat/East Coast at $1,443psf (well under the $1,852 median) is genuine value, and the 1,012sqft 2BR is generously sized. But the 11.03% URA CAGR is computed from only 7 transactions — not reliable, and not something to lean on — and a 30-unit development has shallow, lumpy resale liquidity: a single distressed sale can reset pricing and exits can take time. The high arena score is flattered by the inflated thin-sample rate. Freehold tenure and location keep it off Avoid, but illiquidity caps it at Neutral for a 5-7yr investor who needs a clean exit.
